verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for a service with machine channels like MeF and IRIS A2A, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no user-issuable, least-privilege API credential for an agent. The Transmitter Control Code and e-file provider enrollment are institutional gates, not scoped agent keys. Third-party designee authorization is a paper delegation, not an API credential. Online account access requires personal ID.me biometric verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
